title: Section 18 Registration Act — Documents of which registration is optional

content.heading: Documents of which registration is optional
content.text: Any of the following documents may be registered under this Act: instruments (other than instruments of gift and wills) creating, declaring, assigning, limiting or extinguishing any right, title or interest of a value less than one hundred rupees to or in immovable property; instruments acknowledging receipt or payment of consideration for such creation, declaration, assignment, limitation or extinction; leases of immovable property for any term not exceeding one year, and leases exempted under section 17; instruments transferring or assigning any decree, order or award creating or extinguishing such a right of a value less than one hundred rupees to or in immovable property; instruments (other than wills) relating to movable property; wills; and all other documents not required by section 17 to be registered.
